title: Tell verifiers to reuse recorded fmt, clippy and test results
summary: Retry the failed job narrowly: edit the verifier prompt so verifiers cite Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results rather than rerunning the full suite, running only targeted tests for new behavior, and note it in the changelog. No code changes; the producer must avoid repeated full-suite runs.

defaults_applied.how: Single prompt file plus changelog; no code.
Criteria check that verifiers cite recorded results, not that text exists only.
cargo test -p athena-context run to confirm snapshots still pass.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: Athena's verifiers (and the operator reading verdicts) stop rerunning the full suite and reuse recorded fmt/clippy/test results.
Per the user's reply, scope stays prompt-only plus changelog; the watchdog/resume proposal is not part of this retry.
Producer should run only cargo test -p athena-context while editing and the full suite at most once at the end (or not at all).

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md tells the verifier that the fmt, clippy and test results in the 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' section are recorded for the candidate and must be cited, not rerun, and that the full `cargo test` suite is not to be rerun.

The same prompt says a criterion such as 'cargo test passes' is satisfied by citing the recorded check, and that new behavior is exercised only with targeted commands such as `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`.
The prompt keeps that a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass (the verifier may then run that one check).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite ~11 min) as the reason.
The diff touches only the verifier prompt and CHANGELOG.md: no Rust source, no watchdog or retry machinery.
Run `cargo test -p athena-context`; it passes, showing the prompt edit did not break the brief snapshot tests.

out_of_scope: Producer checkpoints, early-stop watchdog, timed-out status and resumable retry
Reader prompt and brief rendering changes
departures: Narrow prompt-only scope with an explicit instruction to avoid repeated full test runs lowers time and cost versus the reference.
